Wig Price Table: WIG PRICE TABLE  —  minimum selling price (Straight)
Recalculates automatically from supplier prices + Settings. '—' = combination not sold. HD 13x4/6x6 share price columns; HD 13x6/7x7 has separate vendor prices for 180%, 200%, 250%, and 300%.
PRICE BEFORE PROMOTION TABLE  (Minimum + editable € extra)
Uses the Before Promotion Extra (€) from Wig Calculator. This is the crossed-out price shown before the discount.
Calculated from Price Before Promotion × (1 − Discount %) using the discount from Wig Calculator.
Shows the real discount percentage after .99 rounding.
Shows how much higher the before-promotion price is compared with the minimum selling price.
Estimated final net profit after IRS at the promotional price. At the minimum price, this equals the target wig profit.
Estimated final net profit after IRS at the promotional price, using the dynamic wig profit scale.
TOTAL PROFIT AFTER IRS AT MINIMUM SELLING PRICE (€)
Uses the wig minimum/maximum profit range from Settings. Profit increases by length, like bundles and crochet.
Bundles Price Table: BUNDLES PRICE TABLE  —  minimum selling price (300g)
Suggested profit grows with length and texture.

Uses the Before Promotion Extra (€) from Bundles Calculator.

TOTAL PROFIT AFTER IRS AT MINIMUM SELLING PRICE (€)
Shows net profit after IRS if sold at the Minimum Selling Price, not the Promotional Price.
